run.title: Run a task
run.description: Submit one durable job to the connected Core. A Run creates durable work ONLY through Core validation — it is never an instant effect, and the conversational Ask path never submits a job.
run.intentionalEntry: You reached this flow through the explicit Run task entry. Ask and Run stay separate modes: nothing here submits on behalf of a conversation.
run.draftNote: The draft lives in this page's memory only, for the page's lifetime — nothing is stored on disk, and no secret belongs in a task.

form.taskHelp: What the job should do. It is submitted verbatim as the job's task.
form.systemHelp: Standing instructions that accompany the task, submitted verbatim.
form.providerHelp: The provider adapter that will execute the job. The Core reports whether the chosen provider is wired for this core.
form.modelHelp: Left empty, the provider's default model identity executes the task.
form.classificationHelp: The label the Core's egress gate checks before any content may leave for an external provider. An unlabeled task is protected and blocks every real provider.
form.maxOutputHelp: The output budget the Core reserves for the job. The provider's reported actual is never assumed.

review.heading: Pre-submission review
review.empty: Enter a task and choose a provider to review the submission.
review.loading: Reviewing the draft with the Core…
review.failureTitle: The review could not be loaded
review.failureBody: The Core refused the review read. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier; the reference is the safe correlation ID for diagnostics. Fix the draft and re-review.
review.unknownTitle: The review could not be confirmed
review.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the review read. Nothing is known about the submission's review until a read is confirmed — submission stays blocked.
review.blockedHeading: Submission is blocked until these gaps clear:
review.notBlocked: The Core reports no blocking gap for this draft. The Submit path's own validation and authorization remain authoritative at submission time.
review.blockProviderUnwired: The chosen provider is not wired for this core — the Core would never be able to execute the job.
review.blockPermission: The Core's permission decision denies the submission.
review.blockEgress: The Core's egress policy blocks this classification for the chosen provider.
review.blockUnknownEffect: The Core could not determine whether the provider call reaches outside this core — it cannot be told before submission whether external side effects may occur.
review.sourcesNone: No sources attached — the job runs without retrieval.
review.sourcesUnresolved: The source reference could not be resolved. Reason reported by the Core: {{reason}}
review.sourcesUnavailable: Not available — the Core has no pack store to resolve sources against.
review.providerWired: The provider is wired for this core.
review.providerUnwired: The provider is not wired for this core.
review.capabilitiesHeading: Capability facts (the provider's tested claims only)
review.effectsIntro: What this job's execution may do, in the Core's effect vocabulary. Unknown values are shown verbatim — never guessed.
review.classUnknown: Unknown (the Core could not determine it)
review.unknownNeedsReconciliationNote: An unknown outcome is never blindly retried; it forces reconciliation.
review.permissionAllowed: The Core's permission decision allows this submission.
review.permissionDenied: The Core's permission decision denies this submission.
review.policyNoRecord: No data-handling record governs this profile. Reason: {{reason}}
review.egressAllowed: The Core's egress policy allows this classification for the chosen provider.
review.egressBlocked: The Core's egress policy blocks this classification for the chosen provider.
review.approvalNotRequired: The Core's policy requires no approval for this submission.
review.approvalRequired: The Core's policy requires approval for this submission. The approval decision surfaces are a separately tracked capability and do not exist yet; the job would wait until the Core resolves it.
review.budgetAbsent: The Core reports no budget estimate before execution. A provider-reported actual is never assumed, and no cost is invented.
review.factsUnknownValue: unknown (the Core has no verified fact)

submit.heading: Submit
submit.pendingNote: The submission is in flight. Submitting again is disabled until the Core answers.
submit.acceptedBody: The Core accepted the job for processing (202). This is an acknowledgment — NOT completion. The job's durable state is the only truth; follow it on the job's own page.
submit.replayedNote: The Core reports this as a replay: the same idempotency key and input returned the ORIGINAL job — no second job was created.
submit.rejectedBody: The Core refused the submission. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier and the reason is shown as the Core gave it — fix the draft and re-review. Refusals are fix-input or fix-state actions, never re-sends.
submit.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the submission. A lost response is never proof of success, failure, or a safe retry — and it is never shown as either. The submission carries the idempotency key shown below; the Core resolves the same key and input to the original job, never a second one.
submit.unknownResend: Re-send with the same idempotency key
submit.unknownResendNote: The same key and the same input are re-sent exactly as the Core's idempotency contract defines — the Core returns the original job. This is an explicit action, never automatic.
submit.keyUnavailable: No idempotency key could be generated — the submission was not sent. Nothing was submitted; retry when the environment provides a key source.

announce.accepted: The job was accepted for processing.
